class.name: OcgSelect3dSensitiveentity
class.brief_description: Abstract framework to define 3D sensitive entities.
class.description: ! Abstract framework to define 3D sensitive entities.

method.name: OwnerId
method.description: Returns pointer to owner of the entity

method.name: SensitivityFactor
method.description: allows a better sensitivity for a specific entity in selection algorithms useful for small sized entities.

method.name: SetSensitivityFactor
method.description: Allows to manage sensitivity of a particular sensitive entity

method.name: GetConnected
method.description: Originally this method intended to return sensitive entity with new location aLocation, but currently sensitive entities do not hold a location, instead HasLocation() and Location() methods call corresponding entity owner's methods. Thus all entities returned by GetConnected() share the same location propagated from corresponding selectable object. You must redefine this function for any type of sensitive entity which can accept another connected sensitive entity.

method.name: ToBuildBVH
method.description: Returns TRUE if BVH tree is in invalidated state

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears up all resources and memory

method.name: HasInitLocation
method.description: Returns true if the shape corresponding to the entity has init location

method.name: InvInitLocation
method.description: Returns inversed location transformation matrix if the shape corresponding to this entity has init location set. Otherwise, returns identity matrix.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
